insight.title: The Barometer
insight.subtitle: A manager evaluates productivity during a system failure.

sections.text: The warehouse was in chaos after a system failure. Orders were backing up and employees were sprinting to catch up, except for one veteran worker sitting on a crate.
The new supervisor rushed over to fire him for laziness during the crisis. The plant manager stopped him, pointing to the veteran’s calm posture amidst the frantic shouting.
"He's the only one not panicking," the manager whispered. "If he starts running, that’s when I’ll know we’ve actually lost control. For now, he is our barometer."

ENDING:
The most reliable data point in the room wasn't on the screens.
